beats: The first fully finished explainer video exposed problems no one had caught.
It quizzed the kid mid-video instead of just answering their question.
Numbers were vague, and the real explanation got buried under filler.
So a sixth AI editor was added, just to catch exactly that.
It blocks quiz questions, demands real numbers, and protects the explanation.
That core explanation must now fill at least 30 percent of every video.
